answer: To submit your task, log in to your dashboard, open the current task card, and click the 'Submit Work' button. Make sure all required files are attached before submitting.
Each task's deadline is mentioned on its task card in the dashboard. Please submit before the deadline; late submissions may not be considered unless an extension is granted.
You can reach your mentor through the official WhatsApp group or by emailing the support team along with your intern ID and query.
Certificates are issued after you successfully complete and submit all required tasks. It usually takes a few working days to generate once your final task is approved.
Attendance is tracked based on your task submissions and activity on the dashboard; there is no separate daily check-in required.
To update your profile, go to the 'My Profile' section on the dashboard, click 'Edit', make your changes, and save.
If the dashboard isn't loading properly, try clearing your browser cache, refreshing the page, or switching browsers. If the issue continues, report it to support with a screenshot.
If you're unable to log in, double-check your registered email and password. If the issue persists, reset your password or contact support.
To reset your password, click 'Forgot Password' on the login page, enter your registered email, and follow the link sent to your inbox.
Your internship duration is mentioned in your offer letter/onboarding email, typically ranging from 4 to 8 weeks depending on the track.
Tasks are evaluated by mentors based on completeness, correctness, and adherence to the given instructions. You'll receive a status update or feedback on your dashboard.
If your task is marked for resubmission, review the mentor's feedback, make the required changes, and resubmit through the same task card.
Feedback on your tasks is shared on your dashboard under the task status section. Check there after your submission has been reviewed.
Your completion status is visible on the dashboard, showing which tasks are pending, in review, or approved.
For technical issues like errors, broken links, or upload failures, please report them to support with a screenshot and a short description of the problem.
For team-based tasks, coordinate with your assigned teammates and submit as instructed on the task card, whether individually or as a team submission.
For tasks requiring GitHub, push your code to a public repository and paste the repository link in the submission field on your dashboard.
If deployment is required, deploy your Streamlit app (e.g. via Streamlit Community Cloud) and share the live app link along with your GitHub repo link.
Detailed project requirements are listed in the 'Task Instructions' section of each task card. Please read them carefully before starting work.
You may use AI tools for learning and assistance, but your final work should reflect your own understanding. Fully copy-pasted AI output without review may affect your evaluation.
